rule: Mutually exclusive per canonical net: UNKNOWN if ambiguous/no loads/any endpoint unknown; TWO_BOUNDARY_ENDPOINT_DEMAND if combined driver/load SLR set contains SLR0 and SLR2 (subtype direct0to2 or source1_multicast0and2 explicit); ADJACENT_ENDPOINT_DEMAND if combined set is exactly {0,1} or {1,2}; LOCAL_ENDPOINTS if combined set singleton. Minimum boundary demand only, not actual route containment.
